name: Like Button
description: Heart button on tracklist rows and in the now playing bar. A half heart means another version of the same recording is already liked. No Web API calls.

name: Release Date
description: Shows the release year next to the playing track's title, and the full release date in the track context menu.

name: Genre Tags
description: Shows Last.fm genre tags of the playing artist in the now playing bar. Click a tag to open its 'The Sound of' playlist by The Sounds of Spotify.

name: Playing From
description: Shows the playlist, album or artist you are playing from in the now playing bar. Click it to open it. Shows 'Recommended songs' during autoplay.

name: Copy Track Titles
description: Adds 'Copy titles' to the track context menu. Copies the selected tracks as 'Artist - Title' lines.

name: Random Playlist
description: Button next to the Your Library title that plays a random playlist from your library, opens it and scrolls to it in the sidebar.

name: Folder Breadcrumb
description: Shows the library folder path at the top of a playlist page. Click a folder to expand it and jump to it in the sidebar.

name: Folder Alt Click
description: Alt-click a folder arrow in Your Library to collapse or expand it together with all its subfolders.

name: Menu Dividers
description: Groups the track context menu with extra dividers: these extensions, other extensions, then Spotify's own items.

name: Layout Tweaks
description: Shows up to 10 custom app icons in the top bar instead of 4.
